stats.fact: DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview, released around Aug 12-13, 2026, with source code included.
The official deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness GitHub repo has 202,666 stars and 23,326 forks (MIT license).
The DSH Plugin Directory (dshplugin.online) indexed 7,740 plugins from 4,796 authors as of Aug 29, 2026.
Plugin growth exploded from 0 (Aug 12) to 7,740 (Aug 29) in ~2.5 weeks — roughly 1,000+ plugins/day in the first week.
The DSH Plugin Registry (dshplugin.app) indexes 1,545 plugins across 8 categories.
Largest plugin categories by count: Developer Tools 1,446, UI & Productivity 942, Terminal & TUI 667, Security & Policy 604.
The dsh-index package index hosts 119 packages / 188 versions (116 plugins + 2 ready-to-run Agents).
DeepSeek Harness has 9 swappable capability slots: Model, Tools, Skills, Session, Sandbox, Storage, Loop, Scheduling, UI.
Top community plugins: dsh-routing-suite (6.9k stars), DSH Web UI (6.3k stars), ModLens vision plugin (3.7k stars).
The harness is built on the Cordis kernel, described in arXiv paper 2608.25512 'A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability'.

angles: The plugin marketplace grew from 0 to 7,740 plugins in under 3 weeks — one of the fastest-growing plugin ecosystems ever, driven by the 'everything is a plugin' architecture.
Unlike traditional plugin stores, DSH has no central gatekeeper: plugins are indexed from GitHub repos tagged 'dsh-plugin', making it a decentralized, source-backed marketplace.
The 9 capability slots mean you don't fork the harness to extend it — you swap any single capability (model, tools, UI, storage) from configuration.
Security is a first-class concern: registries surface dependency, license, lifecycle-script, and compatibility signals because anyone can publish.
The ecosystem is fragmented across multiple registries (dshplugin.app, dshplugin.online, dsh-index) with differing counts — a guide to navigating them is genuinely useful.
Developer preview means compatibility-breaking changes are expected — plugin churn and version pinning matter for real users.
Ready-to-run Agents (Agent = Harness + Plugins) lower the barrier: install a complete agent profile instead of assembling plugins by hand.
